answers.core: This feature directly enhances the usability of the 3D viewport, which is a fundamental part of the Godot editor. Including it in the core ensures that all users have access to a more intuitive and flexible zooming experience without requiring additional setup. Furthermore, since this change involves modifying core editor settings and behaviors, it is more appropriate to implement it as part of the core rather than as an add-on.
answers.workaround: This enhancement could potentially be implemented as an editor plugin. However, since zooming is a core part of the 3D navigation workflow, implementing it as a plugin would require users to manually install and configure it, which is less convenient. Additionally, a plugin-based solution might not integrate as seamlessly with the existing editor settings and UI.

title: Add "Both" Option for Alt+Right Click Zoom and Sensitivity Setting in 3D View
